rules.title: Prohibition on algorithmic devices used to set rents (Rent Ordinance Section 37.10C)
rules.requirement: The sale or use of algorithmic devices, such as software that analyzes nonpublic competitor rental data to recommend rents for vacant units, to set rents or manage occupancy levels for residential units in San Francisco is prohibited.
rules.key_value: Ban on sale or use of algorithmic rent-setting devices using nonpublic competitor data
rules.quoted_span: The law prohibits the sale or use of algorithmic devices to set rents or manage occupancy levels for residential units in San Francisco.
rules.coverage_text: Residential units in San Francisco; covers devices such as software programs that use algorithms to analyze nonpublic competitor rental data to recommend rent for a vacant unit.
rules.penalty: A tenant or the City Attorney may bring a civil action against an entity believed to be in violation.
